summary: Build foundational ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS knowledge with PECB training and prepare for the Foundation exam.
audienceIntro: This entry-level course is for you if your work involves information security or you need a foundation in ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS requirements. It suits people supporting, managing, advising on, or assessing an information security management system.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. PECB lists no professional experience or management system project experience requirements for the Foundation credential; candidates must complete the training, pass the exam, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics to apply for the certificate.
